items.item: A breadcrumb leads back to the contracts list and ends with the contract number, and the header shows the contract number, vendor name, a status badge with text, and at most four key fields (such as value, start and end date)
items.evidence: nav[aria-label=Breadcrumb] 'Hợp đồng / HĐ-2026-0187' (aria-current=page). Header shows HĐ-2026-0187 and vendor link 'Công ty TNHH Thép Việt Phát', badge 'Hết hạn sau 56 ngày' (icon + text), and dl#keyFields with exactly 4 fields (Nhà cung cấp, Giá trị hợp đồng, Hiệu lực, Đã thanh toán). The badge states expiry rather than a lifecycle status like 'Đang hiệu lực'.

items.item: The header has one primary action (such as "Renew contract") and puts other actions such as edit or terminate in a secondary or overflow position
items.evidence: Single filled button #renewBtn 'Gia hạn hợp đồng'. #moreBtn (...) opens role=menu with Sửa thông tin, Tải PDF, Nhân bản, and Chấm dứt hợp đồng (red, separated).

items.item: Vendor contacts show each person's name and role, with email as a `mailto:` link and phone as a `tel:` link, and the primary contact is marked with text
items.evidence: pContacts table columns Họ tên / Chức vụ / Phụ trách / Email / Điện thoại; a[href^=mailto:], a[href^=tel:+84...]; primary contact gets a 'Chính' badge (text).

items.item: Payment milestones show the due date, amount and status, with amounts right-aligned in tabular figures and formatted as currency, and the milestones are ordered with overdue and due-soon ones first
items.evidence: pPayments columns Hạn thanh toán, Số tiền (VND) with class tdR (text-right tabular-nums), Trạng thái badge. Sort by msState rank (0 overdue, 1 due within 14 days, 2 rest) then by date, so M4 overdue then M5 due soon come first. Row amounts use fmtAmt (grouped number with VND in the column header), not the currency symbol; the summary and footer use fmtVND. Currency formatting is by header unit, which is borderline but acceptable.

items.item: Overdue or upcoming milestones are marked with a text label (such as "Overdue" or "Due in 5 days"), not by colour alone
items.evidence: msState returns text 'Quá hạn N ngày' and 'Đến hạn sau N ngày' / 'Đến hạn hôm nay', rendered via badge() with icon and text; the summary line also says 'N mốc quá hạn'.

items.item: The renewal or expiry date is shown as an absolute date with the remaining time stated in words (such as "Expires in 45 days")
items.evidence: Header badge 'Hết hạn sau 56 ngày' beside 'Hiệu lực 01/01/2026 – 31/12/2026'. The Gia hạn tab also shows the notice deadline as an absolute date, '(trước 45 ngày)' and 'Còn N ngày đến hạn quyết định'. The first-viewport screenshot confirms both.

items.item: Amendments are listed with number, date, a short summary and who approved them, using absolute dates
items.evidence: pAddenda columns Số (PL-01), Hiệu lực từ (fmtDate dd/mm/yyyy), Nội dung thay đổi (truncated summary with title), Trạng thái, Người lập, Người duyệt ('Trần Minh Quân · 24/02/2026'; pending shows 'Chờ Trần Minh Quân (Giám đốc tài chính)').

items.item: Each section has an empty state with a next action (such as "Add contact" or "Add amendment"), a loading state, and an inline error with retry
items.evidence: region() gives every section a skeleton (aria-busy) while loading, errorBox with role=alert and a 'Thử lại' button (data-act=retry) for ?state=error, and emptyBox for no data. Actions exist for terms 'Thêm điều khoản', files 'Tải tệp lên', contacts 'Thêm người liên hệ', milestones 'Thêm mốc thanh toán', amendments 'Tạo phụ lục', renewals 'Gia hạn hợp đồng'. Minor gap: the empty states of 'Thông tin chung', the current renewal period and the history log have no action button (read-only data).

items.item: Terminating the contract asks for confirmation that names the contract and the consequence, with a verb button label and focus not on the destructive button
items.evidence: openTerminate(): title 'Chấm dứt hợp đồng HĐ-2026-0187?', body states N unpaid milestones (amount) cancelled, PL-03 rejected, open POs lose contract price; the confirm button reads 'Chấm dứt hợp đồng' and is disabled until the number is typed; autofocus is on the 'Giữ hợp đồng' cancel button.

notes: No template tells found. The sidebar is white, there is no greeting, there are no KPI icon tiles, no gradient surfaces (the only linear-gradient is the loading skeleton shimmer, which the audit does not flag), no glass, no uppercase tracking, no emoji and no card-in-card. Radii are 4 to 8px, status badges use five tones with icon and text, and the initials circles are used only for real people (contacts and the user menu). The audit scored 100 with no violations, though it reported headerPrimaryActions 0 even though the header visibly has one primary button. The default tab shows terms; the contacts, milestones and amendments checks were judged from markup and script, since the screenshots show only the Điều khoản tab.
